'''Hao Bailin''' ({{zh|c=郝柏林 |p=Hǎo Bǎilín|w=Hao Po-lin}}; 26 June 1934 – 7 March 2018) was a Chinese theoretical physicist, an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]], and [[Fudan University]] professor.

==Biography==
Hao was born in Beijing, 1934. He graduated from then [[Beijing Foreign Studies University|Beijing Russian Institute]] in 1954, then went to [[Kharkiv]] and studied mining at [[Kharkiv National University of Economics|Kharkov Engineering-Economic Institute]]. He transferred to the Department of Mathematics and Physics, [[Kharkiv University]] in 1956 and completed his bachelor's degree in the next three years.

He entered the Institute of Physics, [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] as a trainee researcher afterwards. He went to Moscow State University and Soviet Academy of Sciences for the further studying on physics since 1959.<ref name=":0">{{Cite book|title=中国大百科全书（第二版）|publisher=Encyclopedia of China Publishing House|year=2009|isbn=978-7-500-07958-3|volume=22|pages=294–95|language=zh|trans-title=Encyclopedia of China (2nd Edition)}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.itp.cas.cn/unheadmenu/specdoc/201001/t20100122_2731142.html|title=郝柏林院士中文信息表|website=itp.cas.cn|access-date=9 March 2018|archive-date=8 March 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180308231628/http://www.itp.cas.cn/unheadmenu/specdoc/201001/t20100122_2731142.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Hao had meant to become a postgraduate under [[Lev Landau]], but Landau was injured in a road accident in 1962, he returned to China without a postgraduate diploma.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Hao|first=Bailin|year=2008|title=朗道百年|journal=物理 |trans-journal=Physics |language=zh|volume=37 |issue=9|pages=666–71}}</ref>

He continued his job in CAS until the Cultural Revolution began. During the decade, he participated the Task 1019 for the military.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Hao|first=Bailin|year=2009|title="1019"任务四十年|url=http://www.wuli.ac.cn|journal=物理 |trans-journal=Physics |language=zh|volume=38 |issue=10|pages=743–46}}</ref>  Hao was elected as an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] in 1980. Hao took interdisciplinary research programmes later, he also sequenced DNA since 1997.<ref name=":0"/>

==Personal life==
Hao had three siblings. Their father, Jingsheng was a botanist, thus Bailin was supposedly named after a Chinese native tree, ''[[Cupressus funebris]]''.

Hao met Zhang Shuyu, a Chinese student from Jiangxi province, in Kharkiv. They married in the late 1950s, and had two children.

==Death==
Hao died on 7 March 2018, aged 83.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.cas.cn/xb/gz/201803/t20180308_4637577.shtml|title=中科院院士郝柏林逝世|website=www.cas.cn|language=zh|access-date=9 March 2018}}</ref>
